product_name_specific: FJR1300, MT-10, MT-09, NIKEN, TMAX, XT1200
risk_description:
Due to oxidation, an electrical fault may occur in the brake-light switch that is fitted on the handlebar brake lever.

This may lead to malfunctioning of the cruise control, increasing the risk of an accident.
